messages.en:
So, you're a year older,
huh? Well, anyway, happy
birthday. I guess I'm
happy for ya.
messages.et:
Nii et oled aasta vanem,
mis? Noh, igatahes, palju
õnne. Vist on mul
sinu üle hea meel.

messages.en:
Happy birthday. You're a
little bit older, but not
much wiser! Yeah, that's
too bad for you.
messages.et:
Palju õnne. Sa oled veidi
vanem, aga mitte palju
targem! Jah, see on
sinu jaoks kahju.

messages.en:
I heard you're having a
birthday. I'm not much
for this kind of thing,
but have a present.
messages.et:
Kuulsin, et sul on
sünnipäev. Ma ei ole
selliste asjade mees,
aga võta kingitus.
